title: One companion, three ways to work

features.title: Text, dictation or live voice
features.description: Choose your input mode below the message box. Dictation writes into your draft for you to send; live voice continues the conversation using your own OpenAI account. Switching modes keeps your conversation and draft.

features.title: Name your design and keep developing it
features.description: Choose a name when starting a character or scenery piece. Its folder, brief, concepts, model and design conversation remain in your local library so you can reopen it for adjustments.

features.title: Your campaign remains the orchestrator
features.description: Character and scenery design use the same companion as the campaign. Relevant design discussion is retained with the asset, while campaign planning stays in the campaign workspace.
